summary: Weekday (8:00 and 11:30), Saturday (8:00, 4:00 and 6:00 PM) and Sunday (6, 8, 10 and 12) Masses, weekday and Saturday confession times, and First Friday confession and adoration are all in the page 2 box of every bulletin. First Friday adoration starts 'immediately following' the 11:30 Mass with no clock time, so it is set to 12:00 by policy. Oct 12 Columbus Day: 11:30 explicitly cancelled, 9:00 added, and one open question on whether the 8:00 is also cancelled; Nov 3 Mass of Remembrance included.
